title: Iteration of the gate-evaluation machine
statement: Fix an input width $n$, a bit string $R$, and a list $P$ of bit strings. For every number of steps $T$, work string $w$, and list of natural-number values $vs$, iterating the encoded gate-evaluation machine for $T$ steps from the state with context determined by $n,R,P$ and data $(w,vs)$ gives the encoded state with that same context and data equal to the two components obtained by iterating the abstract decoding-and-evaluation step for $T$ steps from $(w,vs)$, using modulus $\operatorname{val}(R)+1$ and point assignment $i\mapsto \operatorname{val}(P_i)+1$.
